limitations: All dates/assets/data already seen by other studies; no fresh out-of-sample market discovery or prospective day.
Hourly CLOSE extrema/proximity and delayed entry-relative hourly CLOSE barriers; NOT intrabar support first-touch/MSNR/fill probabilities. Actual intrabar both-barrier ordering is unidentified.
Trade closes plus nonzero volume are historical activity proxies, not executable bid/ask/depth, on-time reception or latency certification.
Funding intervals require both adjacent cycle fields to explain the exact gap. Traded-close funding notional is a proxy, not fair/index verified cash.
Fixed4snapshot asset universe includes BTCcontrol and3alts, no point-in-time universe or lot/rule/ownerfee vintage.
Fixed8bp/side includes fee/spread/impact as ONE lumped proxy, no extra spread counted; actual capital-dependent cost/capacity unknown.
Six fixed policies including cash; no calibration/validation winner, tuning, temperature change, leverage-up or cost-tier entry rescue.
10000USDT shared once acrosscoins per alternative account, at most2000 initialgross; markedgross, intrahorizon margin/liquidation and realized risk equivalence not validated.
Funding posts in aggregate at exit; actual intrahorizon margin/equity not validated. Capital stops use known chronological3xshadowcash/100percent initial-notional reserves at alltiers.
Feature gaps, entry failures, path gaps, funding unknowns and inactive days retained. Admitted unknown exposure/cash blocks newrisk; unentered candidate unknown cannot poison account.
Training financial-known subset differs from price-label scoring coverage. Counts and censoring reported; missingness can bias both.
Brier/logloss combine reliability and discrimination; fixedbins report actual frequencies/counts, not calibrated confidence intervals.
Fixed.25sigma decision reserve is heuristic, NOT a calibrated error bound. Joint14day circular shifts retain shared calendars but do not establish exchangeability or a valid pvalue.
Prior R321 interval controls failed their predeclared acceptance. No inference, program-wide significance, positive expected net or activation is granted here.
Any promising result needs new frozen candidate and genuinely on-time prospective quotes/values/risk evidence before admission.
